native.iec104_implementation: Actual device/library revision. Industry does not select protocol transport or timers.
native.iec104_parameter_profile: Baseline interoperability proposals versus actual configured device/factory profile; no overwriting confirmed settings.
native.iec104_role: Actual controlling TCP client or controlled TCP listener; distinct from active/standby redundancy state.
native.iec104_transport: Actual plain TCP versus TLS/TCP binding. No UDP path inferred merely from IANA registration.
native.iec104_ip_version: Actual IPv4/IPv6 addressing of the bound TCP path.
native.iec104_port: Actual remote/listening service port.2404 and19998 are transport-qualified proposals, not physical bit rates.
native.iec104_local_port: Actual local TCP port; ephemeral allocation must be represented by its policy, never guessed as the service port.
native.iec104_lib_int_bits: Actual C ABI signed-int width for the pinned library. Timer multiplication must fit before unsigned casts; no invented32-bit ABI.
native.iec104_abi_source: Actual compiler/target ABI evidence for lib60870 integer timer arithmetic.
native.iec104_peer_endpoint: Actual configured remote hostname/IP and connection identity.
native.iec104_local_endpoint: Actual local address/interface/listener binding, not loopback example.
native.iec104_transport_binding: Actual registered lower-layer TCP/IP/physical path, each layer with its own technology profile.
native.iec104_device_source: Actual device/library/firmware capabilities and accepted settings.
native.iec104_interoperability_source: Actual shared ASDU sizes/types/addressing/security agreement with peers.
native.iec104_physical_source: Actual underlying link/route/PHY/MTU/propagation facts; IEC104 has no universal Ethernet speed.
native.iec104_schedule_source: Actual traffic/APCI windows/ACK/TCP recovery and redundancy schedule.
native.iec104_type_source: Actual type-specific information object/quality/time/private ASDU encoding.
native.iec104_address_source: Actual common address/originator/IOA assignment, not constructor0/1 examples.
native.iec104_command_source: Actual direct/select/execute/cancel and ACT_CON/ACT_TERM acceptance; separate from TCP/APCI ACK.
native.iec104_tls_source: Actual TLS security edition, negotiated version/ciphers/certificates/trust/authorization and record layout.
native.iec104_redundancy_source: Actual approved redundancy groups, client assignments, active connection and event retention.
native.iec104_k: Actual maximum outstanding I-format APDUs before APCI acknowledgment, not a generic Ethernet queue.
native.iec104_w: Actual latest acknowledgment after receiving this many I-format APDUs;2/3k is a recommendation, not a hard format bound.
native.iec104_t0_ms: Actual Connection establishment timeout, separate from reconnect interval. Baseline and factory t0 differ.
native.iec104_t1_ms: Actual I-format/U-test acknowledgment timeout; not application command acceptance. Baseline and factory t0 differ.
native.iec104_t2_ms: Actual Delayed I-format acknowledgment timeout, strictly less than t1. Baseline and factory t0 differ.
native.iec104_t3_ms: Actual Idle link-test interval; disabling tests requires a device-qualified policy. Baseline and factory t0 differ.
native.iec104_reconnect_ms: Actual connection retry interval, distinct from t0 and TCP retransmission.
native.iec104_command_confirmation_ms: Actual application ACT_CON response bound, not t1.
native.iec104_command_termination_ms: Actual application ACT_TERM bound when termination is required.
native.iec104_termination_required: Actual application procedure expects ACT_TERM; omission needs peer/device evidence.
native.iec104_parallel_commands: Actual allowed concurrent application commands, independent from APCI k window.
native.iec104_format: Actual I-data, S-acknowledgment or U-control APCI format with own sequence/content rules.
native.iec104_u_function: Actual STARTDT/STOPDT/TESTFR activation/confirmation, never equivalent to functional completion.
native.iec104_send_sequence: Actual15-bit N(S) modulo32768; not CAN arbitration identifier.
native.iec104_receive_sequence: Actual15-bit N(R) modulo32768; acknowledgment refers to APCI sequence, not application acceptance.
native.iec104_outstanding_apdus: Actual unacknowledged I APDUs bounded by configured k.
native.iec104_unacknowledged_received: Actual receive count awaiting acknowledgment; instantaneous count need not be a queue capacity.
native.iec104_length_l: Actual one-byte length covers4 APCI control bytes plus ASDU; bounded253, separate from2-byte start/length prefix.
native.iec104_length_limit: Actual peer accepted APCI length-L limit; reduced negotiated limit may differ from protocol ceiling253.
native.iec104_apdu_bytes: Actual complete APDU stream bytes: lengthL+2, at most255; not Ethernet frame or ASDU size.
native.iec104_type_id_bytes: Actual agreed type_id_bytes width. Baseline1/1/2/2/3; device-agreed reductions need their own interoperability profile.
native.iec104_vsq_bytes: Actual agreed vsq_bytes width. Baseline1/1/2/2/3; device-agreed reductions need their own interoperability profile.
native.iec104_cot_bytes: Actual agreed cot_bytes width. Baseline1/1/2/2/3; device-agreed reductions need their own interoperability profile.
native.iec104_ca_bytes: Actual agreed ca_bytes width. Baseline1/1/2/2/3; device-agreed reductions need their own interoperability profile.
native.iec104_ioa_bytes: Actual agreed ioa_bytes width. Baseline1/1/2/2/3; device-agreed reductions need their own interoperability profile.
native.iec104_common_address: Actual ASDU common address for configured width.
native.iec104_originator: Actual originator when COT2; absent under COT1.
native.iec104_first_ioa: Actual first information object address for configured1/2/3-byte width.
native.iec104_type_id: Actual ASDU type ID/private type with encoding evidence.
native.iec104_cot: Actual6-bit cause of transmission; negative/test flags remain separate.
native.iec104_object_count: Actual VSQ7-bit information object count; SQ sequence addresses must remain within width.
native.iec104_sequence: Actual SQ contiguous objects/one IOA versus individually addressed objects.
native.iec104_object_layout: Actual fixed-size objects versus explicitly encoded private/variable objects.
native.iec104_object_bytes: Actual encoded fixed object size including quality/time, excluding IOA.
native.iec104_objects_encoded_bytes: Actual full object encoding including required IOAs.
native.iec104_asdu_bytes: Actual ASDU header plus information objects; max249 separate from lengthL253/APDU255.
native.iec104_asdu_limit: Actual peer accepted ASDU limit; constructor249 does not prove a custom peer supports that value.
native.iec104_abb_message_limit_bytes: Actual COM600 Maximum Message Length setting; documentation gives230 default but does not resolve full-APDU versus length-L versus ASDU scope.
native.iec104_abb_message_scope: Actual proven mapping of the vendor message length setting; unresolved scope prevents a capacity claim.
native.iec104_abb_message_scope_source: Actual device/revision proof of vendor message-length scope; no silent255-byte payload conversion.
native.iec104_byte_order: Application Mode1 least-significant octet first; type-specific float/text representations still require evidence.
native.iec104_time_format: Actual NONE/CP24/CP56 ASDU representation, including validity and synchronization semantics.
native.iec104_command_procedure: Actual direct-execute or select-before-operate matching both stations.
native.iec104_server_mode: Actual library single/per-connection/multiple redundancy groups and distinct queue-retention semantics.
native.iec104_group_count: Actual group_count for configured server/group; no queue256, topology or connection count fabricated.
native.iec104_active_connections: Actual active_connections for configured server/group; no queue256, topology or connection count fabricated.
native.iec104_active_per_group: Actual active_per_group for configured server/group; no queue256, topology or connection count fabricated.
native.iec104_max_connections: Actual max_connections for configured server/group; no queue256, topology or connection count fabricated.
native.iec104_low_queue: Actual low_queue for configured server/group; no queue256, topology or connection count fabricated.
native.iec104_high_queue: Actual high_queue for configured server/group; no queue256, topology or connection count fabricated.
native.iec104_low_queue_overflow: Actual event retention/overflow policy; lib drops oldest low-priority event when full.
native.iec104_tcp_segment_bytes: Actual stream segmentation/reassembly bound from lower TCP profile; APDUs may span/coalesce segments.
native.iec104_tls_record_bytes: Actual negotiated TLS wire record size including security overhead; not constant Ethernet overhead.
native.payload_bytes: Actual encoded application data; ASDU249, APCI lengthL253 and fullAPDU255 are separate limits, not TCP segment/Ethernet MTU/security overhead or generic payload255.
